role: non-RULER one-pass natural-reasoning replication of the adaptive layer-quota contrast
prerequisites: terminal digest-bound nine-seed P2 causal audit
terminal Qwen3-4B adaptive-quota RULER audit regardless of outcome
terminal baseline Qwen3-4B LongBench-v2 audit regardless of outcome
verified frozen LongBench-v2 dataset, prompt, scorer, model, and fixed-baseline selection
execution_policy: run all 503 frozen examples under both arms; prerequisite outcomes never select, cancel, truncate, or reorder domains, difficulties, length strata, or examples

benchmark.name: LongBench-v2
benchmark.paired_unit: the same frozen example with identical rendered prompt and exact context/question token ids
benchmark.overflow_policy: retain unsupported-context as an intention-to-evaluate failure scored zero; never truncate
benchmark.secondary_slice_policy: report observed frozen metadata levels with n >= 10 descriptively; no secondary slice is a confirmation gate

natural-adaptive-quota+pins.layer_signal: normalized entropy concentration of z-scored current-layer scorer values
natural-adaptive-quota+pins.causal_prior: running mean of earlier-layer concentrations only

scorer_selection.rule: reuse the frozen score-compatible Qwen selection without LongBench-v2 outcome inspection

cache_lifecycle_contract.question_tokens: append identically after context compression without adaptive reallocation
cache_lifecycle_contract.generation_tokens: decode identically under the arm-specific post-prefill cache
per_successful_example_audit: all 36 initial layer allocations in causal order
configured and observed initial total kept tokens
score concentration and controller time per layer
initial hot-resident bytes, peak HBM, and end-to-end latency

statistics.failure_policy: intention-to-evaluate; every allowed operational or unsupported-context failure scores zero and is never dropped or silently retried

failure_reporting.paired_scoring_policy: retain every frozen example and score allowed failures zero

claim_boundary: A passing result supports bounded transfer of the initial causal layer-quota heuristic from RULER and shared-cache SCBench to one-pass LongBench-v2 multiple-choice reasoning on one Qwen3-4B checkpoint. It does not establish continuous adaptive reallocation, open-ended generation quality, cross-model transfer, the full LongBench benchmark family, or official DeepSeek-V4 behavior.
